summary: 8485 of 8493 tests passed. Three NEW regressions in pkg-parser.test.ts caused by commit b0dc4a35 which added 'headerSize < 8 || headerSize > 1024' validation. This incorrectly rejects V0001 format packages that use headerSize = 0 (documented as valid in the original code comment). The fix should change the lower bound to 'headerSize < 0' or add a special case for V0001's headerSize = 0. Additionally, 1 pre-existing flaky benchmark test (injection-benchmark) and 1 known flaky CDP reconnect test failed but are not regressions.
